if: goods are removed from the supplier's place of business for transportation

the case is one of: supply of liquid gas where the quantity at removal is not known; transportation for job work; transportation for reasons other than by way of supply; or another supply notified by the Board
then: the consigner MAY issue a delivery challan in lieu of an invoice at the time of removal
note: A delivery challan is NOT an invoice and does not evidence a supply by itself. Three of the four cases are movements that are not supplies at all.

supply of liquid gas where the quantity at the time of removal from the place of business of the supplier is not known,
transportation of goods for job work,
transportation of goods for reasons other than by way of supply, or
such other supplies as may be notified by the Board,
